verdict.rationale: Requesty is a hosted LLM gateway, and open-sourcing such a product is plausible, so the openness axis applies. The evidence pack contains no mention of a public source repository or an open license. Its docs cover only hosted features, pricing and documentation endpoints such as llms.txt, which concern docs access rather than source code.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
